title: Tiger and Goat: Bagh-Chal
description: Nepal’s traditional hunt game: four tigers against twenty goats on a board of 25 points. Learn in nine short lessons, play four computer levels or a friend, solve a daily puzzle, or watch Auto Play. Fills the whole screen in portrait and landscape. No ads, works offline. Free preview, then a one-time unlock.

title: Golden Sling
bannerAlt: Golden Sling: pull, aim, release, guard the harvest
description: A hand-carved slingshot, a golden field and birds raiding the crop. Pull back, aim and release to scare them off before the harvest is gone, with wind, combos and a new Daily Hunt every day. Falcons and hawks hunt over the field, there are eight looks for the field and a calm Zen mode, and the field grows to fill your screen. Rules page and Auto Play to watch and learn. Completely free, no ads, works offline.
